race.description: Grandview Receptions - Christmas Bookings Available Mdn Plate
race.comment: SENTALOA (14) has run into the money twice at Bendigo to open his career, and he will don the blinkers for the first time. He has a good draw, and this should be easier, so we have him on top. VESPASIAN (5) has been a touch weak late off the top in his last couple of starts, and he will have the blinkers on for the first time in an effort to help keep his mind fully on the job. He has the right draw to take up the running again, and this time, he may take them all the way. TOP LINER (9) caught the eye with a late finish for sixth over this trip fresh up on this track just over 3 weeks ago. She might be looking for more ground, but the tempo here will be genuine, and she can figure in the top 3 here. NED KELLY (2) has recently been bought out of NZ, and his form had been improving over a middle distance. He has had 3 tune-up jump-outs, and the market will be a great guide. PASSIO (13) slipped at the start last time out, and he is well worth another chance. Stick with him. Each way.
